feature_contract.goal: Preserve the exact first-512 ascending projected-depth classification of OutRun smoke/sand/effect indexed XYZRHW draws while eliminating redundant full index sorts across decoder-stable VB frames and per-UP heap churn.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Limit changes to R30 leased sparse index classification and its deterministic verifier; preserve R30 HUD, world/SkyGlow, eye transforms, Reset fallback, FFB, independent DX11, and frozen DXVK.
feature_contract.special_work_evidence: Quest3 trace shows up to 3298 source Draws with gameRenderCpuMs p95 11.876ms / p99 16.179ms; the existing >512-reference sparse VB classifier reallocates and comparison-sorts 513..2048 references each memo miss, even when decoded IB and referenced mask are unchanged. The specific FPS impact is unmeasured; no runtime uplift claimed.
trace_stages: OutRun original indexed smoke/sand/spray Draw produces validated CPU-shadowed VB/IB spans and local unique index references.
R30 decoded IB tracks revision, bounded referenced mask and first-512 XYZRHW world-depth classification before game Draw and per-eye reprojection.
R33 stereo per-eye draw and OpenXR composition consume unchanged R30 projected-depth/HUD-vs-world classification; 4:3/21:9/Quest3 optics and protected visuals must not regress.
subcomponents: Reuse exact ascending >512-reference VB sort under a validated decoded-index mask generation and invalidate it before changing mask contents.
Reuse UP-only sort capacity without borrowing any VB decoder generations; unknown or corrupt producer hints continue dense ascending fallback.
Extend the existing deterministic source verifier with cache ownership/generation structural checks, destructive mutations and seeded multi-resolution 512-prefix parity/revision scenarios.

acceptance_items.expected_behavior: A stable decoded IB mask with changed VB or projection reuses the same proven first-512 ascending depth reference order across R30 draws, sorting once per generation.
UP index batches reuse storage without adopting VB sort identity; missing, malformed, duplicate and changed-generation hints fall back to the original safe ascending depth scan.

Deterministic positive/negative depth-classifier checks and the final exact-SHA Windows DX9Ex Active policy/game/host/full-chain/package, Domain Isolation and required source-impact checks all succeed.

diagnosis.original_evidence: R30XyzrhwHasProjectedDepthSignature on >512 sparse indexed references used a local dynamic vector, assigned the complete touched list, and std::sort()ed it per classifier miss. Source already caches unchanged IB decode but the sort ignored that stable generation.
diagnosis.root_cause: Projected-depth selector's sorted touched list had only invocation lifetime, so independent VB revisions with the same immutable decoded IB redundantly sorted and allocated thousands of references.
source_trace: OutRun D3D9 IndexedPrimitive VB/IB -> R30CopyIndexShadow/revision snapshot.
R30IndexDecodeCache local mask and vbTouched unique list -> R30XyzrhwHasProjectedDepthSignature ascending first-512 classifier.
Stereo projected-depth decision feeds the R30/R33 per-eye Draw route; no world/HUD semantic or shader changes.
alternatives_rejected: Blindly scanning only unsorted touched references >512 changes the first-512 sample for sparse smoke and potentially misclassifies the world depth signature.
Caching by IB pointer alone would accept DISCARD/moved spans and corrupt classification after Reset; new decoder mask generation and lease/producer identity are required.
Forcing lower game resolution or reducing eye quality would change visible image quality without removing the identified CPU work.
diagnosis.fix_evidence: R30 scratch owns separate VB and UP sorted vectors, with guarded decoded IB generation reuse and invalidation on every decoder miss; raw/no-lease calls preserve old local fallback.
diagnosis.negative_test_evidence: Exact-SHA policy SUCCESS with source/verifier negative mutations, seeded sparse-depth parity, leased producer ownership and 3-generation decoded-IB fixture.

performance_evidence: Eliminates duplicate >512 reference VB sorting between unchanged IB generations, and reuses UP scratch allocations; measurable p95/p99 Quest3 benefit remains UNTESTED.
